1. (Currently Amended) A golf tee comprising a long lasting combination of a golf tee and a force absorbing member in association therewith, said tee including a ground insertion end, a ball support end and a shaft in between, said member surrounding said shaft and being located below said ball support end and having an outer diameter less than that of a golf ball but large enough and located so as to protect said support end from impact from a golf club strike after a golf ball has been struck from said tee, wherein said force absorbing member is __permanently affixed to said shaft__.

2. (Currently Amended) The golf tee of claim 1, wherein said tee is formed from a material that enables the shaft to withstand damage from a strike on the resilient member __and wherein said force absorbing member is formed from a material having a durometer hardness of from about 30 to about 90 durometer__.

3. (Currently Amended) The golf tee of claim 1, wherein said tee is formed from a member selected from the group consisting of wood, plastic and metal, __and wherein said force absorbing member is formed from a material selected from the group consisting of natural rubber, synthetic rubber, neoprene, foam rubber, and polyurethane__.

4. (Currently Amended) The golf tee of claim 3, wherein said tee is formed from a hardwood __and wherein said force absorbing member comprises neoprene__.

5. (Currently Amended) The golf tee of claim 1, wherein said tee is formed from an engineering plastic __selected from the group consisting of polycarbonate and nylon, and wherein said force absorbing member is formed from a material having a durometer hardness of from about 30 to about 90 durometer__.
